verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI document served at https://openrouter.ai/openapi.json (HTTP 200, containing the "openapi" key), so users can download the spec directly. A machine-readable llms.txt is also served, and the docs describe a normalized API schema across models. missing for 10: first-party documentation that points users to or describes the OpenAPI spec, and evidence of the spec's completeness or coverage of all endpoints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://openrouter.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
OpenRouter normalizes the schema across models and providers so you only need to learn one.
